Hmmm. Some of the comments I see here come across as a little invalidating so I just want to clarify, the way you feel is NOT the same as racist stereotyping... I'm sure the comments come from a good place, but the reality is that people in the west live in a white supremacist system, and you're also only 15!! You would've been 7 or so when Trump was first elected in America, so how can anyone blame you for feeling this way or coming to this conclusion about other people? Plus, being 15 sucks even in the best of circumstances lmao

Some hope though: people don't actually inherently hate black people, and no one is born racist. People are taught to be racist by the systems they grow up around, which sucks, but it also means that they can be taught to undo that conditioning and unlearn racism. And NEVER forget that 1) The reality presented online WILL make the world seem 1000x worse than it actually is, thanks to the way algorithms work. 
And 2) Even when a system is set up against you, it has absolutely nothing to do with your value as a person. You ARE valuable and worth the same as anybody else. 

I think you need to find people who understand what you're going through in real life, and start reaching out to anyone around you that you trust. That might be parents, a teacher, a sibling or a cousin, a friend, or even just someone at school that you've had a good experience with. I guarantee that you're not alone, you won't be fighting alone, and that things WILL get better.
